topics.scope: The selected calendar year's changing priorities across work, money and relationships, grounded in its calculated monthly states. Cover the beginning, middle and end of the year. Discuss preparation and choices, never guaranteed events or lucky dates.

zh.title: 年度运程
zh.subtitle: 阶段重点 · 顺势安排
questions: 哪些事情值得提前准备

topics.scope: How the person's initiative, home needs, learning and career responsibilities interact. Explain how to choose priorities when these needs compete. Develop a paid synthesis beyond the free personality traits; do not repeat the yearly forecast or make lifelong success claims.

zh.title: 整体运程
zh.subtitle: 人生主线 · 取舍方向

topics.scope: The interaction between initiative, interests, learning, professional responsibility and support. Explain which strengths work well together, when opportunities can be developed and where the person may overextend. This is a Thai natal-chart synthesis, not a Bazi pattern classification, destiny ranking or success score.

zh.title: 格局解读
zh.subtitle: 优势组合 · 发展空间
questions: 机会怎样转为实际积累

topics.scope: Long-term partnership and marriage: emotional needs, trust, shared responsibilities, boundaries and communication under pressure. Make examples conditional for single and partnered readers. Never assume marital status, predict infidelity or divorce, or infer a second person's chart.

zh.title: 婚姻情感
zh.subtitle: 长期相处 · 沟通经营
questions: 长期相处容易在哪些事上分歧
信任与共同责任怎样经营

topics.scope: The connection between work style, skills, collaboration, income habits and spending choices. Distinguish career development from money management. Discuss practical preparation and agreements without financial product recommendations, invented amounts or promised gains.

zh.title: 财运事业
zh.subtitle: 收入习惯 · 职业发展
questions: 什么工作方式更适合你
收入与消费习惯如何配合
合作与发展怎样做准备

topics.scope: Practical obstacles and avoidable friction: overcommitment, unclear shared obligations, overlooked details and insufficient rest. Give observable conditional warning signs and proportionate responses. A traditional indication is not proof of harm: never predict illness, accidents, death, loss amounts or inevitable misfortune, and never sell remedies.

zh.title: 风险提醒

groups: 易遇阻力与可观察信号

topics.scope: Attraction, getting to know a potential partner, preferred ways of connecting, mutual fit, reciprocity and pacing before commitment. Keep this distinct from maintaining an existing marriage. Do not guarantee a soulmate, partner appearance or occupation, meeting date, marriage age or compatibility without another person's data.

privacyParagraphs: 本页使用你填写的出生资料进行泰式排盘，并将本次需要的盘面依据和问题发送至配置的 AI 模型服务生成解读。

你可以在“我的报告”中删除已保存的报告。正在生成的报告需等待生成结束后再删除。删除所选报告不会撤销已经记录的使用额度。
本页可记录访问、提交和报告展示次数，用于了解页面使用情况。流程统计不包含出生资料、问题正文或模型回答；按最近 30 天汇总，新访问时清理过期资料。尊重浏览器的“不跟踪”和全局隐私控制设置。
付款确认后，即可查看完整报告。地点数据来自 GeoNames，使用 CC BY 4.0 许可。

privacyDetails: 新报告将出生日期、时间、城市坐标和时区发送至 RoxyAPI 进行西洋排盘，再将必要的盘面依据和问题发送至 Qwen 整理解读。访问凭据不会发送给这些服务；排盘无需姓名。旧报告保留原计算来源。
报告保存在本项目后端。当前浏览器保存随机访问凭据，用于再次打开自己的报告；这份凭据不会加入分享链接。清除浏览器存储可能失去原报告的查看入口。
你可以在“我的报告”中删除已保存的报告。正在生成的报告需等待生成结束后再删除。删除所选报告不会撤销已经记录的使用额度。
本页可记录访问、填写进度、提交和报告展示，用于了解页面使用情况。填写进度记录填到哪一步和是否填完，流程统计不包含出生资料、问题正文或模型回答，保留最近 30 天，新访问时清理过期记录。创建报告时可将浏览器访客编号及首次入口的来源、活动、投放地区标签随报告保存。尊重浏览器的“不跟踪”和全局隐私控制设置。
地点数据来自 GeoNames，使用 CC BY 4.0 许可。
